name: Share Bee
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Share Bee adds fast sharing controls to singular WordPress content. Visitors can share a page through WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, or ChatGPT, and can copy the current link.

Features:

  • Buttons before content, after content, or in both positions.
  • Optional left or right floating share bar.
  • Independent visibility controls for posts, pages, and products.
  • WhatsApp, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and Pinterest share buttons.
  • Optional ChatGPT share button.
  • Copy-link button with a browser-compatible fallback.
  • Local plugin assets with no remote news feed or background tracking request.

Share actions occur only when a visitor clicks a share button.

Project Information

Share Bee is developed and maintained by PingBooster, a WordPress plugin and digital-growth platform.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the share-bee folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate Share Bee.
  3. Open Share Bee in WordPress admin and save your preferred display settings.
sections.faq:
Does Share Bee make background requests to a remote service?

No. It does not fetch a remote news feed, advertisements, or promotional content. A visitor’s browser opens the selected sharing service only after the visitor clicks its button.

Can I hide buttons on a content type?

Yes. The settings screen includes separate controls for posts, pages, and WooCommerce products.

Can I disable the ChatGPT button?

Yes. Clear the ChatGPT Sharing option and save the settings.

Where can I find official Share Bee information?

Visit the official Share Bee project page for current product information and documentation.
